notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard explicit MIM federation creation and shared declarations. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies standard MIM composition, reserved designator rejection, MOM handle/name round trips, and ordinary declaration retention without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador explicit-MIM federation creation, join, handle lookup, name lookup, resignation, and destruction services
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador explicit MIM composition declarations
